floorDetail.roomCardsDesc: Each card represents a room on this floor. Click any room card to dive deeper into its specific teachings and exercises.
floorDetail.roomCodesDesc: Every room has a unique code (like SR, OR, CR) used throughout the Phototheology system for quick reference.
floorDetail.practicalAppDesc: Use these rooms when studying Scripture to organize your insights and apply the correct principles to each passage.
floorDetail.floorDesc1: Load the canon's storyline into long-term memory as vivid scenes. Build your foundational library of stories, images, and gems.
floorDetail.floorDesc2: Become a detective of the Word. Gather raw data, define terms, decode symbols, and interrogate the text with precision.
floorDetail.floorDesc3: Master the art of drawing object lessons from everything around you—nature, seasons, the animal kingdom, science, driving, walking, washing dishes, cooking, and all everyday activities. Train your mind to spontaneously connect the physical world with spiritual truth, turning ordinary moments into gospel insights and Scripture connections.
floorDetail.floorDesc4: Expand depth through dimensional, Christ-centered study. See the diamond from five cuts, identify patterns, and test by fruit.
floorDetail.floorDesc5: Open the prophetic telescope. Use God's blueprint—sanctuary, feasts, and Daniel-Revelation—to see the master plan.
floorDetail.floorDesc6: Situate texts in redemptive-historical cycles and cosmic dimensions. Compress entire books through the palace method.
floorDetail.floorDesc7: Bring heart and soul into the fire of experience. Let the text ignite devotion, meditation, and quick recall for live ministry.
floorDetail.floorDesc8: The palace becomes invisible—it's now inside you. Teach naturally; let others identify the rooms you're using.
